lines.beaver: 선생님, 이번 예절 교육은 어떤 내용이에요?
lines.beaver_roman: seonsaengnim, ibeon yejeol gyoyugeun eotteon naeyongieyo?
lines.en: I teach how to speak and act politely.

lines.beaver_en: Do you cover greetings at first meetings too?
lines.learner: 네, 초면에 하는 인사가 제일 중요해요.
lines.en: Yes, greetings at a first meeting matter most.
lines.roman: ne, chomyeone haneun insaga jeil jungyohaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Will you explain terms of address too?
lines.learner: 네, 이번 교육에서 호칭어의 비중이 높아요.
lines.en: Yes, terms of address are a big part of it.
lines.roman: ne, ibeon gyoyugeseo hochingeoui bijungi nopayo.

lines.en: If you address them wrongly, they feel slighted.

lines.beaver_en: Is there content on respecting elders?
lines.learner: 네, 어른을 공경하는 마음도 함께 가르쳐요.
lines.en: Yes, I also teach respect for elders.
lines.roman: ne, eoreuneul gonggyeonghaneun maeumdo hamkke gareuchyeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Do they learn how to apologize too?
lines.learner: 네, 죄송스러운 마음을 정중하게 전하는 법이요.
lines.en: Yes, how to politely express feeling sorry.
lines.roman: ne, joesongseureoun maeumeul jeongjunghage jeonhaneun beobiyo.

lines.beaver_en: How do you do the practice?
lines.learner: 짝을 지어서 인사와 사과를 직접 해 봐요.
lines.en: In pairs, they actually greet and apologize.
lines.roman: jjageul jieoseo insawa sagwareul jikjeop hae bwayo.

lines.beaver_en: Won't just formal greetings be boring?
lines.en: So I stress that sincerity matters more than form.

lines.beaver_en: It's well structured. It'll get good reviews.
lines.learner: 고마워요. 착오가 없게 자료를 다시 볼게요.
lines.en: Thanks. I'll recheck the materials for errors.
lines.roman: gomawoyo. chagoga eopge jaryoreul dasi bolgeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Then let's prepare together from tomorrow.
lines.learner: 좋아요. 미루지 말고 내일 바로 시작해요.
lines.en: Great. Let's not put it off and start tomorrow.
lines.roman: joayo. miruji malgo naeil baro sijakaeyo.
